**Statistics for Product Teams**

Statistics for Product Teams is a six-week online course for product managers, designers, engineers, and analysts who want to rely on more than gut instinct and dashboards, and who don't have a statistics degree.

Dr. Helen Okafor teaches the concepts teams actually use: framing testable hypotheses, designing and running A/B tests, interpreting confidence intervals and p-values, avoiding pitfalls like peeking and underpowered experiments, and explaining uncertainty to stakeholders. Each week has short lessons, real-world case studies, and hands-on exercises you can apply to your own product right away.

By the end, you'll be able to read experiment results critically, ask sharper questions of your data, and make recommendations you can defend.

Start date: September 8
Format: 6 weeks, online
Price: $480
